items.where: every storey on all fronts: rough pale grey-green precast parapet bands, rounded at the corners
items.how: solid concrete prisms of the storey plan, 1.85 m tall on a 3.47 m pitch from 3.05 m, corners rounded to 3.5 m; ribbon glass set 0.5 m back between them

items.where: east, south and west fronts: cream vertical fins standing at an angle between the bands, in pairs
items.how: 0.06 m plates 0.4 m deep turned 29 degrees off the facade normal, alternating 1.3 / 2.6 m along every straight edge of every glazing zone

items.where: south-east sports-hall wing: three bands with a rounded end cantilevered over two columns and recessed curved ground-floor glazing
items.how: wing to 15.3 m on the 3DBAG 14.9 m roof outline, ground-floor glass 2 m back on its free sides, two 0.6 m columns

items.where: east front ground storey: two dark stone-clad piers between the glazed bays
items.how: dark stone blocks 0.1 m proud of the band line from the ground to the first band

items.where: north-east part: one more banded storey to 25.5 m flush with the east and north fronts
items.how: glazing and band storey on the 3DBAG 25.5 m roof outline

walls.note: East front: the main block's banded storeys with fins, rounded at the south-east, the lower hall wing cantilevered at the south, dark stone piers in the glazed ground storey.

items.where: north front middle: a full-height glass atrium over the top three storeys whose roof rises eastwards
items.how: glass prism 15 cm proud of the band line from 13.3 m to a top sloping from 22.6 m (west) to 25.8 m (east), the 3DBAG sloped roof planes; its mullions are not drawn

items.where: north front: ribbon windows with slim pale frames about 2 m apart, no sun fins
items.how: pale 0.12 m mullions on a 2.0 m pitch in front of the glass (frames between them not drawn)

walls.note: North front on the Prinses Irenestraat side: banded storeys with plain ribbon glazing and the glass atrium; no fins.

items.where: south over the schoolyard deck: the upper storeys cantilever on a sloping soffit (the aula tribune) and slim columns
items.how: the three lower storeys stop 12 m north of the diagonal south edge; a concrete wedge between them and the upper storeys with its underside sloping from 6.5 m up to 13.4 m, five 0.6 m columns on the deck

items.where: raised schoolyard deck: white tube cage round the basketball court, low white railing elsewhere
items.how: 0.09 m posts every 3 m with two rails, 4 m tall on the south and south-east edges and 1.1 m elsewhere; the mesh is not drawn

items.where: the deck walls in dark stone cladding, 3.4 m
items.how: dark stone prism on the 3DBAG 3.4 m deck outline

walls.note: South: the deck with its cage and the cantilevered upper block on the sloping soffit.

items.where: west front, fourth band, north end: ST. NICOLAASLYCEUM in red block letters
items.how: pixel-font block letters 1.3 m tall, 11 m long, 0.1 m deep on the band

items.where: west front north part: a dark stone-clad block from the ground to the second band
items.how: dark stone prism 0.12 m proud of the front, 10.2 m long, to 6.5 m

items.where: west end of the cantilever: two slim columns from the street
items.how: two 0.6 m concrete columns 1 m inside the front

items.where: roof: a pale plant-room box at the north-west and the raised east storey either side of the sloping atrium roof
items.how: pale flat-roofed box to 25.3 m with rounded corners on the 3DBAG 25.3 m outline

walls.note: West front: banded storeys with fins, the red school name, the dark stone block, the lower storeys ending round at the setback and the cantilever over two columns.

items.where: south-east corner: wide seating steps up to the deck
items.how: six concrete steps 0.57 m high rising west to the deck in the corner the 3DBAG leaves without a roof

walls.note: South-east: the steps up to the schoolyard deck beside the hall wing.

items.how: pixel-font block letters 0.8 m tall on the dark deck wall
